description: Thai C2C escrow chat benchmark for cascaded hybrid moderation. Labels distinguish normal trade inquiry from off-platform payment/contact circumvention. Empirical motivation: fraud screenshots (N≈100) show most early turns look like normal trade; risky intent concentrates at account/PromptPay/Line sharing turns.

empirical_context.implication: Regex-only misses soft/evasive bait (FN risk); LLM-on-every-message is costly; cascaded hybrid escalates only ambiguous mid-score cases.
